materials.title: Timeless Expressions Shaped by Time
materials.subtitle: Discover the 30-year archival philosophy and exquisite, hand-finished metal textures refined within the Daesin Signature atelier.

mold.title: Artisanal Sand-Cast Molding
mold.desc: Molten metal poured into traditional sand molds, capturing a raw, substantial density and weight that automated mass production can never replicate.

engraving.title: Architectural Etching & Carving
engraving.desc: A meticulous, permanent incision into the metal substrate. Far beyond superficial printing, it ensures absolute structural permanence across decades.

master.title: Sole Master Craftsmanship
master.desc: Entrusted to a single master artisan from texture brushing to structural finishing—honoring the singular integrity of bespoke creation over assembly lines.

hairline.title: Solid Brass Hairline
hairline.desc: Meticulously brushed linear grains that subtly diffuse light. A premier choice for structural facades and high-end brand flagships seeking quiet luxury.

mirror.title: Stainless Polished Mirror
mirror.desc: A flawless, distortion-free mirror finish. It injects a minimalist, avant-garde mood, acting as a striking architectural focal point with chrome’s deep reflectivity.

patina.title: Copper Vintage Patina
patina.desc: An intentional aging process that captures the depth of natural patination. Controlled by our master artisan, each surface bears a singular, museum-quality texture.

process.title: The Journey of a Brand Settling into Space

step1.title: 💬 Creative Direction
step1.desc: Meticulous analysis of your brand identity and spatial tone by our design experts.

step2.title: 📐 Technical Blueprinting
step2.desc: Precision 3D renderings and tangible high-end metal samples for flawless decision-making.

step3.title: 🔨 In-House Atelier Crafting
step3.desc: Master artisans begin hand-finished molding and precision foundry work at our Euljiro studio.

step4.title: 📦 Curated Delivery & Guide
step4.desc: Secure premium packaging accompanied by precise structural templates for effortless installation.
